data.one_liner: Proxies between the Chrome debug protocol and the Dart VM service protocol.
data.what_it_does: The Dart Web Developer Service (DWDS) allows developer tools designed to work with the native Dart VM to also work with Dart Web applications compiled with DDC and run in Chrome. It proxies between Dart VM Service Protocol and Chrome DevTools Protocol.
use_when: You are developing Dart web applications and need to use developer tools like flutter run or webdev serve
You need to bridge the Chrome debug protocol and the Dart VM service protocol
avoid_when: You are building non-web Dart or Flutter applications
strengths: Integrates into webdev serve and flutter run
Enables native Dart developer tools to work with web applications
weaknesses: Specific to web applications running in Chrome
data.setup_notes: Integrated automatically into webdev serve and flutter run.
